newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PDCP falls 13 pct on failed merger talks.
newsitem.headline: PDCP falls 13 pct on failed merger talks.

text.p: The PDCP Development Bank fell by 3.25 pesos, or 13 percent, to 21.75 pesos in early Tuesday trade on news that its planned merger with the AsianBank Corp would not go through, brokers said.

"With their merger talks...(failing) the market is reacting negatively. Both companies are on the losing end considering that if you are a small bank here it is hard to raise capital," said Audi Pantillano, analyst at Angping & Associates Inc.
AsianBank said on Monday it and PCDP were terminating talks on their proposed merger due to "differences of opinion in approaches to the valuation methods."
